entities.name: invoices
entities.label: Invoices
entities.description: Sales and purchase invoices with totals, amounts due, status and dates.

metrics.name: xero.invoices.total
metrics.label: Total
metrics.description: Total value of the invoice including tax in the invoice currency.

metrics.name: xero.invoices.amountDue
metrics.label: Amount due
metrics.description: Outstanding balance still owed on the invoice.

metrics.name: xero.invoices.invoiceCount
metrics.label: Invoices
metrics.description: Number of distinct invoices in the result.

metrics.name: xero.invoices.outstanding
metrics.label: Outstanding
metrics.description: Amount still outstanding after payments: total minus amount due.

metrics.name: xero.invoices.invoicePaidRate
metrics.label: Paid rate
metrics.description: Share of invoice total that has been paid: payments divided by invoice total.

metrics.name: xero.invoices.totalBase
metrics.label: Total (base currency)
metrics.description: Invoice total converted to the organisation base currency using the stored currency rate.

dimensions.name: xero.invoices.invoiceId
dimensions.label: Invoice ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for the invoice in Xero.

dimensions.name: xero.invoices.invoiceNumber
dimensions.label: Invoice number
dimensions.description: Human-readable invoice number shown in Xero.

dimensions.name: xero.invoices.contactId
dimensions.label: Contact ID
dimensions.description: Xero contact linked to this invoice.

dimensions.name: xero.invoices.contactName
dimensions.label: Contact name
dimensions.description: Name of the customer or supplier on the invoice.

dimensions.name: xero.invoices.type
dimensions.label: Invoice type
dimensions.description: Whether the document is an accounts receivable or accounts payable invoice.

dimensions.name: xero.invoices.status
dimensions.label: Status
dimensions.description: Current workflow status of the invoice in Xero. Jepto syncs all statuses including DRAFT, VOIDED, and DELETED — filter before reporting totals.

dimensions.name: xero.invoices.date
dimensions.label: Invoice date
dimensions.description: Issue date of the invoice used for reporting periods.

dimensions.name: xero.invoices.dueDate
dimensions.label: Due date
dimensions.description: Date payment is due on the invoice.

dimensions.name: xero.invoices.currencyCode
dimensions.label: Currency
dimensions.description: Currency code for invoice amounts.

dimensions.name: xero.invoices.reference
dimensions.label: Reference
dimensions.description: Optional reference text entered on the invoice in Xero.

dimensions.name: xero.invoices.fullyPaidOnDate
dimensions.label: Fully paid on
dimensions.description: Date the invoice was fully paid in Xero.

dimensions.name: xero.invoices.currencyRate
dimensions.label: Currency rate
dimensions.description: Exchange rate from invoice currency to the organisation base currency.

dimensions.name: xero.invoices.lineAmountTypes
dimensions.label: Line amount types
dimensions.description: Whether invoice line amounts are Exclusive, Inclusive, or NoTax in Xero.

entities.name: invoice_lines
entities.label: Invoice lines
entities.description: Line items with quantity, unit amount, tax and account code.

metrics.name: xero.invoice_lines.quantity
metrics.label: Quantity
metrics.description: Sum of quantities across invoice line items.

metrics.name: xero.invoice_lines.unitAmount
metrics.label: Unit amount
metrics.description: Sum of unit prices before tax on line items.

metrics.name: xero.invoice_lines.lineAmount
metrics.label: Line amount
metrics.description: Gross line amount from Xero. Not P&L-grade on its own — use lineAmountNet for expense/revenue analysis.

metrics.name: xero.invoice_lines.taxAmount
metrics.label: Tax amount
metrics.description: Tax component on invoice line items.

metrics.name: xero.invoice_lines.lineCount
metrics.label: Line items
metrics.description: Number of distinct invoice line items.

metrics.name: xero.invoice_lines.lineAmountNet
metrics.label: Line amount (net)
metrics.description: Tax-exclusive line amount: line amount minus tax amount.

dimensions.name: xero.invoice_lines.lineId
dimensions.label: Line ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for a line item on an invoice.

dimensions.name: xero.invoice_lines.invoiceId
dimensions.label: Invoice ID
dimensions.description: Parent invoice for this line item.

dimensions.name: xero.invoice_lines.description
dimensions.label: Description
dimensions.description: Text description of the line item.

dimensions.name: xero.invoice_lines.accountCode
dimensions.label: Account code
dimensions.description: Chart of accounts code assigned to the line.

dimensions.name: xero.invoice_lines.accountName
dimensions.label: Account name
dimensions.description: Chart of accounts name denormalised on the line.

dimensions.name: xero.invoice_lines.taxType
dimensions.label: Tax type
dimensions.description: Tax treatment applied to the line item.

dimensions.name: xero.invoice_lines.date
dimensions.label: Line date
dimensions.description: Invoice date carried on the line for time-based reporting.

metrics.name: xero.contacts.contactCount
metrics.label: Contacts
metrics.description: Number of distinct contacts in the result.

dimensions.name: xero.contacts.contactId
dimensions.label: Contact ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for the contact in Xero.

dimensions.name: xero.contacts.name
dimensions.label: Contact name
dimensions.description: Display name of the customer or supplier in Xero.

dimensions.name: xero.contacts.email
dimensions.label: Email
dimensions.description: Primary email address stored on the contact.

dimensions.name: xero.contacts.isCustomer
dimensions.label: Is customer
dimensions.description: Whether the contact is flagged as a customer in Xero.

dimensions.name: xero.contacts.isSupplier
dimensions.label: Is supplier
dimensions.description: Whether the contact is flagged as a supplier in Xero.

dimensions.name: xero.contacts.updatedAt
dimensions.label: Updated at
dimensions.description: Last time the contact record was updated in Xero.

metrics.name: xero.accounts.accountCount
metrics.label: Accounts
metrics.description: Number of distinct chart of accounts entries.

dimensions.name: xero.accounts.xeroAccountId
dimensions.label: Account ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for the account in Xero.

dimensions.name: xero.accounts.code
dimensions.label: Account code
dimensions.description: Chart of accounts code used on transactions.

dimensions.name: xero.accounts.name
dimensions.label: Account name
dimensions.description: Name of the account in the chart of accounts.

dimensions.name: xero.accounts.accountType
dimensions.label: Account type
dimensions.description: Xero account type such as revenue or expense.

dimensions.name: xero.accounts.accountClass
dimensions.label: Account class
dimensions.description: High-level classification of the account.

dimensions.name: xero.accounts.status
dimensions.label: Status
dimensions.description: Whether the account is active in Xero.

entities.name: payments
entities.label: Payments
entities.description: Payments received and made, and how long invoices took to pay.

metrics.name: xero.payments.amount
metrics.label: Amount
metrics.description: Total payment amount in the payment currency.

metrics.name: xero.payments.paymentCount
metrics.label: Payments
metrics.description: Number of distinct payments in the result.

metrics.name: xero.payments.daysToPay
metrics.label: Days to pay
metrics.description: Average days between invoice date and payment date for invoices that have been paid.

dimensions.name: xero.payments.paymentId
dimensions.label: Payment ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for the payment in Xero.

dimensions.name: xero.payments.invoiceId
dimensions.label: Invoice ID
dimensions.description: Invoice this payment was applied against.

dimensions.name: xero.payments.contactId
dimensions.label: Contact ID
dimensions.description: Contact associated with the payment. Falls back to the linked invoice contact when the payment row has no contactId.

dimensions.name: xero.payments.contactName
dimensions.label: Contact name
dimensions.description: Display name of the contact on the payment. Falls back to the linked invoice contact when the payment row has no denormalised name.

dimensions.name: xero.payments.date
dimensions.label: Payment date
dimensions.description: Date the payment was recorded in Xero.

dimensions.name: xero.payments.currencyCode
dimensions.label: Currency
dimensions.description: Currency code for the payment amount.

entities.name: organisation
entities.label: Organisation
entities.description: Your Xero organisation's details, base currency and financial year.

metrics.name: xero.organisation.organisationCount
metrics.label: Organisations
metrics.description: Number of distinct Xero organisations synced for the connection.

dimensions.name: xero.organisation.organisationId
dimensions.label: Organisation ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for the Xero organisation.

dimensions.name: xero.organisation.name
dimensions.label: Organisation name
dimensions.description: Trading name of the Xero organisation.

dimensions.name: xero.organisation.legalName
dimensions.label: Legal name
dimensions.description: Legal entity name registered in Xero.

dimensions.name: xero.organisation.baseCurrency
dimensions.label: Base currency
dimensions.description: Organisation base currency used for converted totals and P&L reporting.

dimensions.name: xero.organisation.countryCode
dimensions.label: Country
dimensions.description: Country code for the Xero organisation.

dimensions.name: xero.organisation.financialYearEndMonth
dimensions.label: Financial year end month
dimensions.description: Month (1-12) when the organisation financial year ends in Xero.

dimensions.name: xero.organisation.financialYearEndDay
dimensions.label: Financial year end day
dimensions.description: Day of month when the organisation financial year ends in Xero.

dimensions.name: xero.organisation.updatedAt
dimensions.label: Updated at
dimensions.description: Last time organisation settings were updated in Xero.

entities.name: profit_and_loss
entities.label: Profit and loss
entities.description: Profit and loss report lines by section, account and period.

metrics.name: xero.profit_and_loss.amount
metrics.label: Amount
metrics.description: P&L amount in organisation base currency from the Xero Reports API (tax-exclusive layout). Sum only with profit_and_loss.rowKind=account unless intentionally using a summary row.

metrics.name: xero.profit_and_loss.rowCount
metrics.label: P&L rows
metrics.description: Number of distinct P&L report rows.

dimensions.name: xero.profit_and_loss.reportId
dimensions.label: Report row ID
dimensions.description: Stable primary key for a flattened P&L report row (section, account, period).

dimensions.name: xero.profit_and_loss.periodStart
dimensions.label: Period start
dimensions.description: Start date of the P&L report period.

dimensions.name: xero.profit_and_loss.periodEnd
dimensions.label: Period end
dimensions.description: End date of the P&L report period.

dimensions.name: xero.profit_and_loss.section
dimensions.label: Section
dimensions.description: P&L section such as Income or Less Operating Expenses.

dimensions.name: xero.profit_and_loss.accountCode
dimensions.label: Account code
dimensions.description: Chart of accounts code for the P&L row.

dimensions.name: xero.profit_and_loss.accountName
dimensions.label: Account name
dimensions.description: Account name from the Xero P&L report.

dimensions.name: xero.profit_and_loss.rowKind
dimensions.label: Row kind
dimensions.description: account for leaf account lines; summary for Xero subtotal rows such as Gross Profit or Net Profit. Filter rowKind=account when summing revenue or expense accounts to avoid double counting.

dimensions.name: xero.profit_and_loss.currencyCode
dimensions.label: Currency
dimensions.description: Organisation base currency for P&L amounts.

dimensions.name: xero.profit_and_loss.date
dimensions.label: Report date
dimensions.description: Primary reporting date for P&L rows (period end).
